notes: 去掉「工作区显示」卡片编辑态那条强调色说明条：编辑与否只看标题行那个按钮（「修改」/「完成」），不再多插一行黄底提示。其余不变——整卡一个按钮、会话行自带开关与底色分隔线。
notesEn: Removed the highlighted banner that appeared above the workspace list in edit mode. Whether you are editing is now read from the single Edit/Done button in the card header; no extra tinted row is inserted. Everything else stays: one button for the whole card, and each session row carries its own toggle with a background and divider.
